title: Drift-immune, sample-matched comparison of GLODAP DIC trends with tracer-based anthropogenic carbon (TRACE): code and derived results
description: Code, configuration and derived result tables for the manuscript 'Upper-ocean carbon accumulates 16-18 % faster than tracer-based anthropogenic CO2 estimates predict'. Raw GLODAPv2.2023, eMLR(C*) and CMIP6 inputs are not redistributed; research/preprocessing/build_dataset.py rebuilds them with checksum verification.
